description_en: Starts or stops protection for one or more ECS instances in a scaling group
description_zh: 开始保护或者停止保护伸缩组内的一台或者多台ECS实例
kebab_example: aliyun ess set-instances-protection --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --protected-from-scale-in true --instance-id i-28wt40000 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetInstancesProtection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to protect ECS instances from being terminated or removed from the scaling group during a scale-in activity. Valid values: 

true: Protects the ECS instances.
false: Does not protect the ECS instances
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组自动缩容时是否保护ECS实例，使该实例不被终止或移出伸缩组。取值范围： 

true：保护ECS实例。
false：不保护ECS实例。
parameters.name: protected_from_scale_in

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance
parameters.name: instance_id
